list.name: Releases
list.expr: label_replace(count by (namespace, image_spec) (kube_pod_container_info{namespace=~"offby1-cc|artistlabco-com|artistlabco-com-staging|mautic-artistlabco-com|plane|matchmark", image_spec=~"ghcr.io/0xc0-labs/.*"}) unless count by (namespace, image_spec) (kube_pod_container_info{namespace=~"offby1-cc|artistlabco-com|artistlabco-com-staging|mautic-artistlabco-com|plane|matchmark", image_spec=~"ghcr.io/0xc0-labs/.*"} offset 10m), "version", "$1", "image_spec", "[^@]*:([^@:]+)(@.*)?")

description: One board for every application, chosen with the app variable: health, web vitals, traffic, releases compared, latency, errors and pods.

panels.description: The application, its environment, and links to its traces, its logs and its Argo CD application.

options.content:
$app
env $env · faro ${faro} · traces ${tsvc}
TracesLogsArgo CD

panels.title: Ready
panels.description: Ready replicas of the namespace's Deployments and StatefulSets, against the replicas they ask for.

targets.expr: sum(kube_deployment_status_replicas_ready{namespace="$app"}) + (sum(kube_statefulset_status_replicas_ready{namespace="$app"}) or vector(0))
sum(kube_deployment_spec_replicas{namespace="$app"}) + (sum(kube_statefulset_replicas{namespace="$app"}) or vector(0))

panels.title: Release running
panels.description: The image tag of our own images in the namespace, as kube-state-metrics reports the pods (the CMS's image aside).

targets.expr: count by (version) (label_replace(kube_pod_container_info{namespace="$app", image_spec=~"ghcr.io/0xc0-labs/.*", image_spec!~".*-cms:.*"}, "version", "$1", "image_spec", "[^@]*:([^@:]+)(@.*)?"))

panels.title: Pool
panels.description: The pools (0xc0.cc/pool) of the nodes its pods run on.

targets.expr: count by (label_0xc0_cc_pool) (kube_pod_info{namespace="$app", node!=""} * on (node) group_left (label_0xc0_cc_pool) max by (node, label_0xc0_cc_pool) (kube_node_labels))

panels.title: Nodes
panels.description: The nodes its pods run on.

targets.expr: count by (node) (kube_pod_info{namespace="$app", node!=""})

panels.title: Availability · 30 d
panels.description: Requests to the app's routes that did not end in a 5xx, over 30 days, at Traefik. SLO 99.9%: amber below it, coral below 99.5%.

targets.expr: 1 - (sum(increase(traefik_service_requests_total{exported_service=~"httproute-$app-.*", exported_service!~"httproute-$app-staging-.*|.*otel-gateway.*", code=~"5.."}[30d])) or vector(0)) / sum(increase(traefik_service_requests_total{exported_service=~"httproute-$app-.*", exported_service!~"httproute-$app-staging-.*|.*otel-gateway.*"}[30d]))

panels.title: Requests / s
panels.description: Requests to the app's routes at Traefik.

targets.expr: sum(rate(traefik_service_requests_total{exported_service=~"httproute-$app-.*", exported_service!~"httproute-$app-staging-.*|.*otel-gateway.*"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: p95
panels.description: 95th percentile of the app's answer time at Traefik.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le) (rate(traefik_service_request_duration_seconds_bucket{exported_service=~"httproute-$app-.*", exported_service!~"httproute-$app-staging-.*|.*otel-gateway.*"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: 5xx share
panels.description: 5xx responses as a share of the app's requests.

targets.expr: (sum(rate(traefik_service_requests_total{exported_service=~"httproute-$app-.*", exported_service!~"httproute-$app-staging-.*|.*otel-gateway.*", code=~"5.."}[$__rate_interval])) or vector(0)) / sum(rate(traefik_service_requests_total{exported_service=~"httproute-$app-.*", exported_service!~"httproute-$app-staging-.*|.*otel-gateway.*"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: 4xx share
panels.description: 4xx responses as a share of the app's requests.

targets.expr: (sum(rate(traefik_service_requests_total{exported_service=~"httproute-$app-.*", exported_service!~"httproute-$app-staging-.*|.*otel-gateway.*", code=~"4.."}[$__rate_interval])) or vector(0)) / sum(rate(traefik_service_requests_total{exported_service=~"httproute-$app-.*", exported_service!~"httproute-$app-staging-.*|.*otel-gateway.*"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Web vitals · p75 of real visits
LCP
panels.description: 75th percentile of LCP from Faro (Loki, kind=measurement), good under 2500, poor from 4000 (web.dev). An app without a frontend has none.

targets.expr: quantile_over_time(0.75, {service_name=~"${faro:raw}"} | kind="measurement" | logfmt | type="web-vitals" | app_environment="$env" | value_lcp!="" | unwrap value_lcp | __error__="" [$__range]) by ()

panels.title: INP
panels.description: 75th percentile of INP from Faro (Loki, kind=measurement), good under 200, poor from 500 (web.dev). An app without a frontend has none.

targets.expr: quantile_over_time(0.75, {service_name=~"${faro:raw}"} | kind="measurement" | logfmt | type="web-vitals" | app_environment="$env" | value_inp!="" | unwrap value_inp | __error__="" [$__range]) by ()

panels.title: CLS
panels.description: 75th percentile of CLS from Faro (Loki, kind=measurement), good under 0.1, poor from 0.25 (web.dev). An app without a frontend has none.

targets.expr: quantile_over_time(0.75, {service_name=~"${faro:raw}"} | kind="measurement" | logfmt | type="web-vitals" | app_environment="$env" | value_cls!="" | unwrap value_cls | __error__="" [$__range]) by ()

panels.title: FCP
panels.description: 75th percentile of FCP from Faro (Loki, kind=measurement), good under 1800, poor from 3000 (web.dev). An app without a frontend has none.

targets.expr: quantile_over_time(0.75, {service_name=~"${faro:raw}"} | kind="measurement" | logfmt | type="web-vitals" | app_environment="$env" | value_fcp!="" | unwrap value_fcp | __error__="" [$__range]) by ()

panels.title: TTFB
panels.description: 75th percentile of TTFB from Faro (Loki, kind=measurement), good under 800, poor from 1800 (web.dev). An app without a frontend has none.

targets.expr: quantile_over_time(0.75, {service_name=~"${faro:raw}"} | kind="measurement" | logfmt | type="web-vitals" | app_environment="$env" | value_ttfb!="" | unwrap value_ttfb | __error__="" [$__range]) by ()

panels.title: Traffic and latency
panels.description: Requests per second (area) and p95 (line, right axis) at Traefik; releases and syncs marked.

targets.expr: sum(rate(traefik_service_requests_total{exported_service=~"httproute-$app-.*", exported_service!~"httproute-$app-staging-.*|.*otel-gateway.*"}[$__rate_interval]))

histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le) (rate(traefik_service_request_duration_seconds_bucket{exported_service=~"httproute-$app-.*", exported_service!~"httproute-$app-staging-.*|.*otel-gateway.*"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: Top pages
panels.description: Page loads by URL (one TTFB measurement per navigation), from Faro.

targets.expr: topk(10, sum by (page_url) (count_over_time({service_name=~"${faro:raw}"} | kind="measurement" | logfmt | type="web-vitals" | app_environment="$env" | value_ttfb!="" [$__range])))

panels.title: Devices
panels.description: Sessions started, mobile or desktop, from Faro's session_start events.

targets.expr: sum by (browser_mobile) (count_over_time({service_name=~"${faro:raw}"} | kind="event" | logfmt | event_name="session_start" | app_environment="$env" [$__range]))

panels.title: Signals by release
panels.description: Each release on its own traffic, over the range: web vitals and JS errors from Faro (app_version), memory and CPU per pod from the pods running its image tag. Lower is better on every row: the change is green when A is lower than B, coral when higher. p95 and errors by release are beside it, from Tempo.

targets.expr: label_replace(label_replace(quantile_over_time(0.75, {service_name=~"${faro:raw}"} | kind="measurement" | logfmt | type="web-vitals" | app_environment="$env" | app_version="$va" | value_lcp!="" | unwrap value_lcp | __error__="" [$__range]) by (), "signal", "LCP p75 (ms)", "", ""), "slot", "A", "", "")

label_replace(label_replace(quantile_over_time(0.75, {service_name=~"${faro:raw}"} | kind="measurement" | logfmt | type="web-vitals" | app_environment="$env" | app_version="$va" | value_inp!="" | unwrap value_inp | __error__="" [$__range]) by (), "signal", "INP p75 (ms)", "", ""), "slot", "A", "", "")

label_replace(label_replace(quantile_over_time(0.75, {service_name=~"${faro:raw}"} | kind="measurement" | logfmt | type="web-vitals" | app_environment="$env" | app_version="$va" | value_cls!="" | unwrap value_cls | __error__="" [$__range]) by (), "signal", "CLS p75", "", ""), "slot", "A", "", "")

label_replace(label_replace(quantile_over_time(0.75, {service_name=~"${faro:raw}"} | kind="measurement" | logfmt | type="web-vitals" | app_environment="$env" | app_version="$va" | value_ttfb!="" | unwrap value_ttfb | __error__="" [$__range]) by (), "signal", "TTFB p75 (ms)", "", ""), "slot", "A", "", "")

label_replace(label_replace(1000 * (sum(count_over_time({service_name=~"${faro:raw}"} | kind="exception" | logfmt | app_environment="$env" | app_version="$va" [$__range])) or vector(0)) / sum(count_over_time({service_name=~"${faro:raw}"} | kind="measurement" | logfmt | type="web-vitals" | app_environment="$env" | app_version="$va" | value_ttfb!="" [$__range])), "signal", "JS errors / 1,000 loads", "", ""), "slot", "A", "", "")

label_replace(label_replace(avg_over_time((avg(sum by (pod) (container_memory_working_set_bytes{namespace="$app", container!=""}) * on (pod) group_left () max by (pod) (kube_pod_container_info{namespace="$app", image_spec=~".*:$va(@.*)?"})))[$__range:5m]) / 2^20, "signal", "memory / pod (MiB)", "", ""), "slot", "A", "", "")

label_replace(label_replace(avg_over_time((avg(sum by (pod) (rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{namespace="$app", container!=""}[5m])) * on (pod) group_left () max by (pod) (kube_pod_container_info{namespace="$app", image_spec=~".*:$va(@.*)?"})))[$__range:5m]) * 1000, "signal", "CPU / pod (millicores)", "", ""), "slot", "A", "", "")

label_replace(label_replace(quantile_over_time(0.75, {service_name=~"${faro:raw}"} | kind="measurement" | logfmt | type="web-vitals" | app_environment="$env" | app_version="$vb" | value_lcp!="" | unwrap value_lcp | __error__="" [$__range]) by (), "signal", "LCP p75 (ms)", "", ""), "slot", "B", "", "")

label_replace(label_replace(quantile_over_time(0.75, {service_name=~"${faro:raw}"} | kind="measurement" | logfmt | type="web-vitals" | app_environment="$env" | app_version="$vb" | value_inp!="" | unwrap value_inp | __error__="" [$__range]) by (), "signal", "INP p75 (ms)", "", ""), "slot", "B", "", "")

label_replace(label_replace(quantile_over_time(0.75, {service_name=~"${faro:raw}"} | kind="measurement" | logfmt | type="web-vitals" | app_environment="$env" | app_version="$vb" | value_cls!="" | unwrap value_cls | __error__="" [$__range]) by (), "signal", "CLS p75", "", ""), "slot", "B", "", "")

label_replace(label_replace(quantile_over_time(0.75, {service_name=~"${faro:raw}"} | kind="measurement" | logfmt | type="web-vitals" | app_environment="$env" | app_version="$vb" | value_ttfb!="" | unwrap value_ttfb | __error__="" [$__range]) by (), "signal", "TTFB p75 (ms)", "", ""), "slot", "B", "", "")

label_replace(label_replace(1000 * (sum(count_over_time({service_name=~"${faro:raw}"} | kind="exception" | logfmt | app_environment="$env" | app_version="$vb" [$__range])) or vector(0)) / sum(count_over_time({service_name=~"${faro:raw}"} | kind="measurement" | logfmt | type="web-vitals" | app_environment="$env" | app_version="$vb" | value_ttfb!="" [$__range])), "signal", "JS errors / 1,000 loads", "", ""), "slot", "B", "", "")

label_replace(label_replace(avg_over_time((avg(sum by (pod) (container_memory_working_set_bytes{namespace="$app", container!=""}) * on (pod) group_left () max by (pod) (kube_pod_container_info{namespace="$app", image_spec=~".*:$vb(@.*)?"})))[$__range:5m]) / 2^20, "signal", "memory / pod (MiB)", "", ""), "slot", "B", "", "")

label_replace(label_replace(avg_over_time((avg(sum by (pod) (rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{namespace="$app", container!=""}[5m])) * on (pod) group_left () max by (pod) (kube_pod_container_info{namespace="$app", image_spec=~".*:$vb(@.*)?"})))[$__range:5m]) * 1000, "signal", "CPU / pod (millicores)", "", ""), "slot", "B", "", "")

panels.title: p95 by release
panels.description: 95th percentile of server spans, release A and B overlaid (Tempo, service.version).

panels.title: Errors by release
panels.description: Server spans in error per second, by release (Tempo).

panels.title: Rollout · share of requests
panels.description: Each release's share of the server spans over time (Tempo, service.version).

panels.title: Latency distribution
panels.description: Server span durations over time, darker is more (Tempo).

panels.title: Slowest operations
panels.description: p95 and calls by span name over the range (Tempo); a row opens that operation's traces in Explore.

panels.title: Errors
panels.description: Server lines at error and above in the namespace, and the browser's exceptions from Faro.

targets.expr: {k8s_namespace_name="$app"} | detected_level=~"(?i)(error|fatal|critical)"
{service_name=~"${faro:raw}"} | kind="exception" | app_environment!="probe"

panels.title: Pods
panels.description: Each pod: its phase and node, restarts, CPU against its requests (the pods set no CPU limit) and memory against its limit.

targets.expr: max by (pod, phase, node) ((kube_pod_status_phase{namespace="$app"} == 1) * on (namespace, pod) group_left (node) max by (namespace, pod, node) (kube_pod_info{namespace="$app"}))
sum by (pod) (kube_pod_container_status_restarts_total{namespace="$app"})
sum by (pod) (rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{namespace="$app", container!=""}[5m])) / sum by (pod) (kube_pod_container_resource_requests{namespace="$app", resource="cpu"})
sum by (pod) (container_memory_working_set_bytes{namespace="$app", container!=""}) / sum by (pod) (kube_pod_container_resource_limits{namespace="$app", resource="memory"})

list.name: va
list.label: release A
list.description: A release of ours seen in the namespace in the last 30 days; the newest by default.

list.name: vb
list.label: release B
list.definition: query_result(count by (version) (label_replace(max_over_time(kube_pod_container_info{namespace="$app", image_spec=~"ghcr.io/0xc0-labs/.*", image_spec!~".*-cms:.*"}[30d]), "version", "$1", "image_spec", "[^@]*:([^@:]+)(@.*)?")) unless on (version) label_replace(vector(1), "version", "$va", "", ""))

query.query: query_result(count by (version) (label_replace(max_over_time(kube_pod_container_info{namespace="$app", image_spec=~"ghcr.io/0xc0-labs/.*", image_spec!~".*-cms:.*"}[30d]), "version", "$1", "image_spec", "[^@]*:([^@:]+)(@.*)?")) unless on (version) label_replace(vector(1), "version", "$va", "", ""))

list.description: The release to compare A with; the one before A by default.
